1.w: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

2.w: For knowing wisdom and discipline, for discerning words of understanding,

3.w: for receiving the instruction of wisdom, righteousness, and justice, and uprightness,

4.w: for giving to the simple ones prudence, to a youth knowledge and discretion.

5.w: Let the wise hear and add to instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel,

6.w: to understand a proverb and a parable, the words of the wise ones and their riddles.

7.w: The fear of YHWH [is] the beginning of knowledge; wisdom and instruction fools have despised.

8.w: Hear, my son, the discipline of your father, and do not forsake the instruction of your mother.

9.w: For a garland of grace they [are] to your head, and pendants for your neck.

10.w: My son, if sinners should entice you, do not be willing.

11.w: If they say, “Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us hide for the innocent one without cause;

12.w: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit;

13.w: all precious wealth we will find, we will fill our houses with plunder;

14.w: let your lot fall in our midst—one purse there shall be for all of us!”—

15.w: My son, do not walk in the way with them; withhold your foot from their path;

16.w: for their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.

17.w: For the net is spread in vain in the eyes of any owner of the wing,

18.w: and they lie in wait for their own blood; they lurk for their own souls.

19.w: Such [are] the ways of everyone being greedy for dishonest gain—the soul of its masters it takes away.

20.w: Wisdom calls aloud in the street; in the open squares she gives forth her voice.

21.w: At the head of the clamoring she cries out; at the openings of the gates in the city she speaks her words:

22.w: “Until when, O simple ones, will you⁺ love simplicity, and those mocking delight themselves in mockery, and the foolish ones hate knowledge?

23.w: Turn back at my rebuke; behold, I will pour out on you⁺ my spirit; I will make known my words to you⁺.

24.w: Because I have called and you⁺ refused, I have stretched out my hand, and no one is paying attention;

25.w: and you⁺ have neglected all my counsel, and you⁺ did not consent to my rebuke.

26.w: I also will laugh at your⁺ calamity; I will mock the coming of your⁺ dread;

27.w: your⁺ dread comes like a storm, and your⁺ calamity like a whirlwind comes, in the coming upon you⁺ of distress and anguish.

28.w: Then they will call on me, and I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, and they will not find me,

29.w: upon that they hated knowledge and they have not choosen the fear of YHWH.

30.w: They did not consent to my counsel; they have despised all my reproof.

31.w: And they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and from their own counsels they shall be filled.

32.w: For the turning away of the simple ones slays them, and the complacency of fools destroys them.

33.w: And the one listening to me will dwell [in] safety, and will be at ease from the dread of evil.”
